notes.title: When the Past was Around - Coming on Sep 22, 2020!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5485678/fc8b824047bbdf28662d8f9aa9501219332f9128.png[/img]

Frem the creators of [i]A Raven Monologue[/i] and [i]Coffee Talk[/i].

We are very delighted to announce that our project, [b]When the Past was Around[/b] by Mojiken Studio and Toge Productions will be available on Steam on September 22, 2020.

When the Past was Around is an adventure puzzle-escape game about love, loss, moving on, and letting go. Experience the ups and downs with Eda and Owl.

Watch the announcement trailer here:
https://youtu.be/0Ayvr0pILnU

Follow and wishlist the game now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1164050/When_The_Past_Was_Around/

If you've played our previously released game, [i]A Raven Monologue[/i] and [i]She and the Light Bearer[/i], you will enjoy this game as well. 


Wish us luck for the release!

Have a great day/evening!

- - - - -

Follow us on Twitter!
http://twitter.com/togeproductions

Join our community!
http://discord.gg/toge

notes.title: A Raven Monologue Patch 1.1 Notes
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31444367/6d6c1661da9890dc991a2685b73f079af3878639.jpg[/img]

Good day, everyone!

First of all, thank you so much for your support for A Raven Monologue! We're so happy to see that many people love the game and show their support.

And here are some updates for Windows version.

[h1]Important Changes[/h1]
[olist]
[*]Steam overlay is now working. Hurray!
[*]Steam screenshot shortcut is also working! Immortalize your best memories with Sir Raven!
[/olist]

Have a nice day!
